messages.content: Translate each English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Preserve meaning, names, scripture references, and unit order. Do not add explanations or content. Output JSON only: {"book_code":"JASHER","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"source_ref":"1:1","text_ar":"..."}]}. Return exactly one row for each input source_ref.

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:1","verse":1,"text":"And these are the names of the sons of Noah: Japheth, Ham and Shem; and children were born to them after the flood, for they had taken wives before the flood."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:2","verse":2,"text":"These are the sons of Japheth; Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, seven sons."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:3","verse":3,"text":"And the sons of Gomer were Askinaz, Rephath and Tegarmah."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:4","verse":4,"text":"And the sons of Magog were Elichanaf and Lubal."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:5","verse":5,"text":"And the children of Madai were Achon, Zeelo, Chazoni and Lot."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:6","verse":6,"text":"And the sons of Javan were Elisha, Tarshish, Chittim and Dudonim."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:7","verse":7,"text":"And the sons of Tubal were Ariphi, Kesed and Taari."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:8","verse":8,"text":"And the sons of Meshech were Dedon, Zaron and Shebashni."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:9","verse":9,"text":"And the sons of Tiras were Benib, Gera, Lupirion and Gilak; these are the sons of Japheth according to their families, and their numbers in those days were about four hundred and sixty men."},{"chapter":7,"source_ref":"7:10","verse":10,"text":"And these are the sons of Ham; Cush, Mitzraim, Phut and Canaan, four sons; and the sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama and Satecha, and the sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan."}]}
